verdict.rationale: Cognee's own docs say it extracts entities and builds a knowledge graph in one call, stores data as permanent graph memory, and can link entity types and mentions to canonical ontology concepts. That clearly delivers the core of entity-centric graph memory. Multi-hop answering is supported only by founder-reported HotpotQA results, with no first-party documentation of relationship modeling or multi-hop traversal in retrieval, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: first-party documentation of relationship/edge extraction and multi-hop graph traversal in recall, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-hop or entity-centric answer quality.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable

citations.quote: It ingests, chunks, extracts entities, and builds the knowledge graph for you in one call.
Store data as permanent graph memory or fast session memory in one call.
making sure that entity types ("classes") and entity mentions ("individuals") extracted from your data are linked to canonical, well-defined concepts.
testing on HotpotQA with human labeling achieved 87% answer accuracy using Cognee's ECL pipeline approach with FalkorDB integration.
